identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical ligand name used in the literature for an actinium-225 labeled PSMA-targeting therapeutic.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 225Ac-PSMA-XT is an investigational prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-targeted radioligand therapy. The PSMA-binding ligand delivers the alpha-emitting radionuclide actinium-225 to PSMA-expressing tumor cells, causing highly localized radiation-induced DNA damage and tumor cell death.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Ligand binding to PSMA on tumor cells followed by delivery of actinium-225 and its alpha-particle emissions, producing dense ionization tracks and double-strand DNA breaks in targeted cells and nearby microenvironment.
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Tumor targeting is based on PSMA expression; physiologic uptake is also expected in PSMA-expressing normal tissues such as salivary glands and kidneys.

clinical_settings: Investigational use in advanced PSMA-positive prostate cancer
typical_use.scope: Not approved; reported in early clinical/investigational radioligand therapy settings.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: On-target uptake of PSMA-targeted radioligands in salivary gland tissue can expose glands to alpha radiation.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Established class effect for PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy; specific incidence for 225Ac-PSMA-XT not firmly established in accessible sources.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Radiation exposure from systemic alpha-emitting radioligand therapy may affect bone marrow, especially in heavily metastatic disease.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Plausible and reported for PSMA radioligand class; agent-specific quantitative rates not established here.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Renal handling and physiologic PSMA-related uptake may expose kidneys to radiation.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Plausible class-related toxicity; agent-specific quantitative rates not established here.
